concerns.text: The plan states it will “stream‑download the open‑source NetFlow dataset (`keys-i/netFlow`) as a substitute for CTU‑13” (see line 9). However, Functional Requirement FR‑001 explicitly requires ingestion of NetFlow records **from the CTU‑13 dataset**. Using a different dataset violates the requirement and means the analysis will not be evaluating the intended CTU‑13 traffic, potentially invalidating the research question. Either the FR‑001 spec must be updated to accept the NetFlow dataset, or the plan must be changed to download and use the CTU‑13 data as originally required.
